action.objective: Commit d5f7, a verified forced mate-in-3, delivering checkmate as White's bishop coordinates with the rook.
action.rationale: d5f7 is the sole commit_ready move. Broad depth-4 search scored it top at 99997 (mate band), and single-candidate verification reproduced 99997 with PV Bf7 Kh7 Rh4#. Safety is complete: no immediate Black mate, no checking-reply refutation. It is far stronger than the f6f7 promotion alternative (2158). Black's king on h6 is boxed in, and the bishop on f7 plus rook on g4 deliver mate.
